settings.editor: A Tennessee summer is brutal on your HVAC system. Without an annual tune-up, your air conditioner can lose up to 10% efficiency every year. Our certified technicians perform a deep-clean and safety inspection that prepares your unit for the "muggy" July heat, ensuring it runs perfectly when you need it most.
We don't just "look" at your system; we calibrate it for peak performance. Our maintenance includes:

icon_list.text: Cleaning Condenser Coils: Removes dirt and debris to improve heat transfer and lower energy costs.
Checking Refrigerant Levels: Ensures your system isn't under-charged, which prevents frozen coils.
Tightening Electrical Connections: Prevents the blown capacitors and failed motors that cause emergency calls.
Clearing Condensate Drains: Flushes out algae and sludge to prevent water damage in your home.
Lubricating Moving Parts: Reduces friction, quiets the system, and extends the life of your motor.
